name: BepInEx Framework
author: crystal-mods (packaging); BepInEx contributors (runtime)
description: The BepInEx 5.4.23.5 (x64) modding runtime for Black Book. A shared dependency required by the Traditional Chinese Localization plugin (BlackBookTcFont.dll). Install this once, then install the localization mod. Ships the official BepInEx 5.4.23.5 win-x64 release plus the UnityDoorstop loader; no game files are modified.
provides: BepInEx 5.4.23.5 x64 runtime (winhttp UnityDoorstop proxy + BepInEx/core)
